categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the 'Tests' label and modifies src/test/data/script_tests.json, but the category excludes tests that pin the behavior of a specific area.
categories.rationale: The test infrastructure category covers testing machinery rather than tests of a particular area, specifying that a test pinning one area's behavior belongs to that area instead. This change adds test vectors to script_tests.json covering interpreter.cpp signature and public key validation logic, so it belongs to consensus or script validation rather than test infrastructure.
